You're paying for five apps to do one job.

A texting app for leads. A separate calendar for booking. A spreadsheet for revenue. A review tool bolted on the side. Every handoff between them is a place a lead can go cold.

The Black Arrow platform puts the whole job in one login: CRM, unified inbox, two-way texting, booking, quiz funnels, missed-call text-back, review collection, win-backs, referral tracking, and revenue reporting.
